subject: Fast-track merit + equity supplementation for key engineering hire (S. Alvarez)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fast-track merit + equity supplementation for key engineering hire (S. Alvarez)

Hi Laura / Rishi,

Quick note — we have a time-sensitive situation with a prospective senior infra engineer, Sofia Alvarez (introduced by Veridian Health). Compensation mismatch surfaced late in the process: her target market comp is ~20% higher than the offer we extended last week. Recruiting negotiated a revised base + signing bonus, but Sofia has asked for a small equity refresh on top of the standard offer to accept.

Why this matters: Sofia is a rare profile (LLM infra + production reliability) and Veridian indicated product timelines will slip if we don't secure her for the May onboarding window. Losing her likely pushes their PoC timeline by weeks and jeopardizes a strategic deployment.

Request: approve a one-time merit-equivalent supplement (pro-rated bonus-style payment of 10% of base) plus a small equity top-up (3,000 RSUs, 1-year cliff accelerated to 6 months) as an exception to the standard equity bands. Total headcount/comp impact fits within the FY27 hiring allowance but requires exception sign-off because it exceeds the band cap for the role.

I've attached: offer_summary_SAlvarez.pdf, comp_grid_snapshot_MAY2027.xlsx, and a draft comp-exception-form.

Timing: Sofia needs a final answer by end-of-day Monday (May 10) to meet the vendor relocation schedule. Can we do fast-track sign-off? If approved, I'll route to People Ops for formal entry.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Strategic GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fast-track merit + equity supplementation for key engineering hire (S. Alvarez)

Ben — thanks for the clear context and urgency. A few quick clarifying questions before I sign off:

- Is this candidate being hired as an IC or will they report into Rishi's org? (Impacts band and leveling.)
- Can you confirm the total OTE (base + bonus + signing) you expect after the supplement? I see the comp_grid but want a single-line total.
- Why accelerate the cliff to 6 months rather than the standard 12 for refreshes? Any retention / milestone tied to the acceleration?

If you can reply with those points I can take it to the comp committee for an expedited review. If the committee needs to convene, we can do a short +15 from 4–4:15pm today.

Also copying People Ops (I looped Monica) — Monica, this will need the comp-exception-form and an updated Workday req entry if approved.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fast-track merit + equity supplementation for key engineering hire (S. Alvarez)

On May 9, 2027 at 10:03, Laura Bennett wrote:
> Ben — thanks for the clear context and urgency. A few quick clarifying questions before I sign off:
> - Is this candidate being hired as an IC or will they report into Rishi's org?
> - Can you confirm the total OTE (base + bonus + signing) you expect after the supplement?
> - Why accelerate the cliff to 6 months rather than the standard 12 for refreshes?

Ben — short answers:
- She will report into my org as a senior engineer (IC).
- Proposed total first-year comp (blended): base $210,000 + one-time signing $30,000 + supplement payment $21,000 = $261,000. Equity top-up ~3,000 RSUs (estimated value at grant: $90k).
- Cliff acceleration is conditional: 50% vests at 6 months contingent on delivery of a scoped infra milestone (internal staging rollout for Veridian). Remaining vests per standard schedule. The milestone aligns with the business need and is measurable.

Given the business impact and the milestone tie, I support the exception. If People Ops confirms there are no policy/legal blockers, please proceed to the comp committee for a same-day review.

Rishi
VP, Engineering

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Eliza Castillo <eliza.castillo@veridianhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Fast-track merit + equity supplementation for key engineering hire (S. Alvarez)

Thanks all — appreciate the quick replies and alignment.

Laura/Monica: please treat this as an expedited comp-exception request. Attached is the filled comp-exception-form; key fields: role = Senior Infrastructure Engineer, report = rishi_malhotra, total first-year cash impact = $261,000, one-time supplement = $21,000, equity refresh = 3,000 RSUs with 50% 6-month milestone acceleration.

Rishi: I'll confirm milestone language with Sofia and Veridian, and get a signed acceptance once People Ops clears the form.

Eliza (Veridian): we are prioritizing this; I will confirm final offer by EOD tomorrow and coordinate start dates. Thanks for pushing on logistics.

Action items:
- Laura/Monica: run the comp committee out-of-band (fast-track) and confirm Workday entry if approved.
- Ben: capture milestone language and route signed offer to People Ops.
- Rishi: prepare the deliverable acceptance criteria for the 6-month milestone.

If anyone wants to jump on a 15-min call to expedite, propose now or 4pm today.

Ben
Head of Strategic GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
